csv_scope_of_work: The CITY OF JACKSON, MISSISSIPPI ("CITY" OR "CITY OF JACKSON") seeks specific qualifications from companies approved by the Mississippi Development Authority ("MDA") to operate as Energy Services Companies (ESCOs).
